metadata.title: The Hidden Ingredient of Indian Street Food with Anubhav Sapra
metadata.description:
#advertisement #paidvideo

⚠ Is palm oil used in households and street food really bad? Here’s the REAL truth!🌴 🍟
There’s a lot said about palm oil but how much of it is actually true? 🤔
As someone who’s explored India’s most iconic street foods, I wanted to understand what
science really says. ✔
From crispy samosas to pakoras and chaat, palm oil plays a key role in the taste and
texture that we all love. 😋
So, is it truly harmful or have we been believing myths without checking the facts? 🔍
In this video, I uncover:
✅ Why palm oil is widely used in Indian snacks and kitchens
✅ Scientific insights
✅ Why moderation matters for every cooking oil
✅ India’s move toward self-reliance in edible oils 🌱 (cultivation support for farmers)
Let’s choose facts over fear and balance over bias! 💡
Watch, share & let’s start a real conversation 👇
#PalmOilFacts #IndianStreetFood #HealthyEating #FoodScience #PalmOilMyths
#FoodExplorer #StreetFoodIndia #EatSmart #SustainableOilProduction
#NationalEdibleOilMission #OilPalmYojana #MPOC
